profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | Deployment | DevOps | Troubleshooting | API Developer | AI | Spring Boot | PostgreSQL | Java
profile.summary:
Java Full Stack Engineer with 7+ years of experience delivering scalable enterprise applications and cloud-native systems across consulting and SaaS environments.

Contributed to enterprise initiatives at Infosys and Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), building high-performance backend services and full-stack solutions that improved system reliability, enhanced customer-facing workflows, and supported large-scale production deployments. At TCS, implemented an interactive quote-support system that enabled customers requesting Cisco product quotes to submit clarification queries — improving purchasing confidence and reducing ambiguity in the sales process. At Infosys, consistently delivered production-ready code with fewer than five client-reported complaints across tenure, demonstrating strong engineering discipline and attention to quality.

My work spans cloud-native architecture and modern frontend engineering:
• Designed RESTful microservices using Java 17 and Spring Boot
• Built responsive, dynamic UIs with React, Angular, and TypeScript
• Deployed containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes
• Supported AWS environments including EC2, S3, RDS, and IAM

I combine secure engineering practices with business-focused execution:
• Implemented OAuth2 and JWT authentication for secure access control
• Optimized database performance across SQL and MongoDB systems
• Reduced production defects through disciplined testing with JUnit and Mockito
• Delivered features under Agile frameworks with consistent on-time sprint completion

Most recently, I architected and built Sunnyside Pet Care, a full-stack platform integrating booking workflows, backend services, and automated email notifications — demonstrating end-to-end ownership from concept through deployment.

I thrive at the intersection of scalable backend systems and intuitive frontend experiences — translating business requirements into reliable, secure, and maintainable software that supports growth and customer trust.

projects.title: Job Tracker
projects.description: I created a project that allows users to track the jobs they are applying for: when they have been offered, they applied, they got interviewed for, they got rejected, or they got accepted. Plus you can add notes to the jobs.
